name: Hypromellose Eye Drops
dosing: Instil 1–2 drops in the affected eye(s) as required; for severe dry eye may be used hourly or more frequently with preservative-free formulations
interactions: No clinically significant systemic interactions; separate administration timing when using topical ophthalmic medications to avoid washout
monitoring: Assess symptom relief, ocular surface health and need for preservative-free formulations in frequent users or contact lens wearers
pregnancy: Considered safe for topical ocular use in pregnancy
sideEffects: Transient visual blurring after instillation; rare hypersensitivity or local irritation
pharmacokinetics: Acts locally on the ocular surface with minimal systemic absorption
clinicalPearls: Preservative-free preparations preferred for frequent use or in contact lens wearers; lubricants provide symptomatic relief but address only surface dryness
indication: Dry eye syndromes, tear film deficiency and contact lens–related discomfort
